below: * Differentiations of trace-conditioned inhibitors are very easily subjected to dis-inhibition and are very unstable. It can be noticed in the above experiment that the first application of the organ pipe No. 16, the after-effect of which should have inhibited the secretory action of the metronome, failed to do so, when applied, as in this experiment, as the first stimulus after an interval of 24 hours from the preceding experiment. The second application of the organ pipe No. 16 exerted a powerful inhibitory after-effect, giving a secretion of only 15 divisions with a latent period of over 15 seconds as compared with a secretion of 90 divisions with a very short latent period with the use of organ pipe No. 15.
